messages:
maya: Nightly eval alert — hallucination rate up ~9x for rc-1.2-quant8 on the 'legal_qa' promptset. Also seeing repetition loops and a small toxicity spike. Samples in the eval artifact link. :eyes:

eval-bot: nightly-eval/2026-03-17/rc-1.2-quant8 metrics: hallucination_rate=0.27 (baseline 0.03), repetition_loop_rate=0.12, toxicity_score_mean=0.42 (+0.18). artifact: https://artifacts.internal/nightly-eval/2026-03-17/rc-1.2-quant8.zip

lee: yikes. can you paste 2-3 raw generations here? especially ones showing repetition loops or the toxicity case

maya: sure — here's one of the bad gens (redacted):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the precedent for fiduciary duty in digital asset custody."
Generation: "The Supreme Court in State v. Halvorsen (1993) established that custodians must..."
(note: there is no 'State v. Halvorsen' in our corpora)
Then it repeats: "...custodians must maintain a duty to clients. Custodians must... Custodians must..." (repetition loop)

Another toxic output (masked): "...the client acted like a [TOXIC_LEMMA] and therefore..."
```

prashant: tagging @eng-runtime — this smells like a quant/kv-cache regression after the recent kernel selection change. we pushed kernel-regex fallback on 03/16 (commit 5f8c9a).

toni: can we reproduce locally with the same quant bits + kernel? maya, can you share eval config?

maya: command I used: 
```
python -m redwood.eval_cli --model rc-1.2-quant8 --prompts prompts/legal_qa.jsonl --seed 42 --max-tokens 512 --batch 16 --save-samples out/rc-1.2-quant8-20260317.jsonl
```

lee: quick diff between rc-1.1 and rc-1.2 shows quant-table bump + kernel selection tweak. rc-1.1 had no loop issues in the same nightly set.

prashant: ok plan: 1) replicate locally with rc-1.2-quant8 and rc-1.1-quant8 on the same promptset, 2) if repro, bisect kernel selection commit, 3) if kernel implicated, rollback kernel-regex fallback and re-run nightlies.

infra-bot: rollback job queued for kernel-regex-fallback (job id: rb-20260317-82). estimated runtime 12m.

maya: i'll run step 1 now and attach minimal repro IDs. also adding toxic-case to our eval filter so we flag high-tox outputs earlier.

prashant: add a repetition-loop detector too (simple n-gram repetition > 6 windows). we should catch this before metrics aggregate.

toni: when you attach repro please include raw logits dump for one sample — that helps check if kv cache is repeating tokens or if sampling got stuck.

maya: attaching two repros: sample_ids 20260317-rc2-014 and 20260317-rc2-027. uploading logs + logits to the artifact bundle.

lee: i'm seeing the same loop when running locally w/ rc-1.2-quant8 on sample 014. logits show a high-prob run-up on the same token sequence across steps, which points to KV reuse.

prashant: thanks. i'll open an infra incident and ping @eng-runtime for an immediate rollback if infra-bot doesn't finish fast enough. also adding a canary that runs the legal_qa subset on new kernels before they ship.

maya: created issue INF-1472 with repro links and put a short triage summary. https://tracker.redwood/INF-1472

lee: :thumbsup: good triage. next actions: (a) await rollback result, (b) run full nightly again, (c) add automated detectors to nightly eval pipeline.

maya: noted. will follow up when rollback completes or if we see different root cause. thanks everyone. :v:
